global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with tender chashu pork and a perfectly halved soft-boiled egg. It sits in a blue-rimmed bowl on a wooden table, bathed in warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle natural imperfections.
regions.bowl: The ceramic ramen bowl has a glossy blue and white patterned rim with repeating "Shin" text and small logos.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, pale yellow, with visible noodles and green garnish floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A dark, metallic spoon with a curved handle and reflective surface, partially submerged in ramen broth.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk, creamy white, and smooth surface with slight sheen.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show tender, pale meat with slight fat marbling and green onion garnish on their surface.
